column1: # Korean words (or parts of words) that the pronunciation rules in ko/g2p_ko.py read wrongly.
# One entry per line: written<TAB>pronounced, both Hangul. The reading is spelled as pronounced
# (the rules still run over it and must leave it unchanged; tests check this). Entries are matched
# anywhere inside a word, longest first, so a stem entry also covers the word with particles.
# --- ㄴ before ㄹ read ㄴㄴ (exceptions to liquidization, rule 20)
# --- Sino-Korean ㄹ + ㄷ ㅅ ㅈ tensified (rule 26)
# --- coda neutralized before a vowel-initial real morpheme, then liaison (rule 15)
# --- nouns with ㄺ before ㄱ (the ㄹ rule is for verb stems)
# --- 밟- reads ㅂ before a consonant (rule 10)
# --- noun 삶 (rule 24 tensifies after the verb stem 삶-, not the noun)
